title: Opus 5.5 dark-fantasy boss rush built on Spawn
author: MajidManzarpour
selftext:
**DEUS** is a dark-fantasy boss rush, built in conversation with Savi, the AI on [spawn.co](http://spawn.co) powered by Opus 5.5.   
  
All of it came out of that back-and-forth. Ask me anything about how it was made and play for free 👉 [https://www.spawn.co/@majid/deus/play](https://www.spawn.co/@majid/deus/play)

Btw.. [Spawn](https://spawn.co) takes a different approach to building games with AI, you actually build your game while you are inside them. The code and technical stuff happens in the background, think "holodeck" experience.   
  
It's also a multiverse where your players can travel between games. I've been building my games there lately and getting some early traction. It's free to build on right now, while they develop the platform.
